errors.evidence: The description states that the slices are arranged roughly clockwise by size. However, they are arranged counter-clockwise in descending order of size. Starting from the largest slice (社会常识, 47.23%) and moving counter-clockwise, the sequence is 19.2%, 13.88%, 11.67%, and 8.02%.
